data_coverage_and_listing_audit.survivorship_and_listing_note: Universe comes from local 5m parquet snapshot (C:/Quant-trading/data_lake/klines/5m, 340 files total: 1 stablecoin USDCUSDT excluded + 1 short-history symbol 牛来USDT with 438 5m rows / 36 1h bars excluded = 338 evaluated symbols). All 339 eligible-name 5m files (including all 338 evaluated symbols) end at 2026-08-31 23:55:00+00:00 5m open (2026-08-31T23:00:00+00:00 1h bar open / 2026-09-01T00:00:00+00:00 1h bar close); 0 symbols in the 338-coin 5m scan extend to 2026-09-29 (whereas in the separate 14-coin benchmark load_1h_for_oos, 6 symbols extend to 2026-09-29T23:00:00+00:00 via SharedMarketData 1h and 8 symbols end at 2026-08-31T23:00:00+00:00 via data_lake 5m). First observed bar timestamp in a local file reflects data-file start rather than an official exchange listing registry. Because the local lake is a survivorship-conditioned snapshot of currently present files and lacks delisted historical perpetuals, ROLLING_PIT_TOP50_VOL is survivorship-conditioned on available files, though strictly point-in-time with respect to observed data start dates and trailing 63-day [t_m - 63d, t_m) volume/wick eligibility checked BEFORE wave/cooldown consumption.
